# Garema Place Surgery

> Your GP in Canberra City

Garema Place Surgery has been providing health care to residents of the city and surrounding areas since 2000. The practice is located on the 1st Floor of the Florina Building in Garema Place, Canberra City, above Capital Pathology. Its philosophy is that General Practice is the cornerstone of health care, taking a holistic approach that focuses not only on management of conditions but on prevention. Garema Place Surgery aims to be your health care home.

As of 24 June 2026, Garema Place Surgery is part of the YourGP family, owned by Drs John and Mel Deery. The doctors and team remain the same, with no change to patient care.

## Key Information

- **Address**: 1st Floor, Florina Building, Garema Place, Canberra City ACT 2601
- **Phone**: (02) 6257 1000
- **Email**: reception@garemaplacesurgery.com.au
- **Hours**: Monday to Friday 8.00am until 6.00pm, Saturday 9.00am until 12.00pm. Closed Sundays and all Public Holidays.
- **Booking**: By phone, or online via [AMS online booking](https://automedsystems.com.au/ams/clinics/40/garema-place-surgery-canberra-city-2601/doctors/) (also available via the AMS Doc Connect app for iPhone/iPad)
- **Billing**: Private billing — payment is requested at the time of consultation (cash, eftpos or credit card; DVA cards are not accepted as payment). The practice has Medicare Easyclaim and can process your Medicare refund on the spot. A Standard Consultation (under 20 minutes) is $115.00 (Saturday fee $130.00), a Long Consultation (20-40 minutes) is $205.00, and a Prolonged Consultation (over 40 minutes) is $280.00. Concession card rates and Medicare rebates are detailed in the full fee list, available from Reception.
- **New patients**: Very welcome (individual doctors' availability for new patients varies — see Doctors page)
- **After hours**: Canberra Afterhours Locum Medical Service (CALMS), located at Calvary and Canberra Hospitals — phone (02) 6260 3300. More information at findahealthservice.act.gov.au.

## Services

- Women's Health
- Breastfeeding Medicine
- Men's Health
- Paediatrics and childhood health checks
- Tongue Tie assessment/release
- IUD insertion
- Immunisation
- Travel medicine and vaccination including Yellow Fever
- Chronic disease management/Care Plans
- Skin Cancer Screening
- Pre employment medicals
- Minor Skin Procedures
- Audiometry
- Spirometry
- Health Assessments
- Telehealth Appointments
